# Belgian Train Liveboard

An independent, non-commercial web application that shows live Belgian train
departures and arrivals in an interface styled after the information boards
installed in Belgian railway stations.

It is not an official SNCB/NMBS product, and it is not affiliated with,
endorsed by, or operated by SNCB/NMBS, Infrabel or iRail. The SNCB/NMBS names
and trademarks remain the property of their respective owners.

Live railway information is provided through the iRail API.

## Capabilities

- Live Departures board for any Belgian station: times, destinations, delays,
  platforms, platform changes, cancellations and service alerts.
- Live Arrivals on the same board, switched from the board title: origins,
  scheduled arrival times, delays and platforms.
- Station search over real iRail station data, in all four languages.
- Up to five favourite stations; the last chosen station is remembered.
- Nearest station from the browser's location, only when the location button
  is pressed. The position is not stored or sent anywhere.
- Direct From -> To filtering: shows only departures whose own route calls at
  the chosen destination, without a change of train.
- Train Details: the full route of a train as a timeline, with per-stop times,
  platforms, delays and occupancy where the operator reports it.
- Optional route map drawn from preprocessed Infrabel open railway data, on
  OpenStreetMap base tiles, when the route can be matched. The drawn route is
  approximate.
- Historical Performance for the opened train at the station on screen:
  typical delay, on-time rate and 90th-percentile delay over a recent 10, 15
  or 30-day window, shown only with enough comparable journeys.
- Kiosk mode for unattended displays.
- Multilingual interface: FR / NL / EN / DE.
- Shareable links for stations, boards and individual trains.

## URLs

- Departures (default, no board parameter): ?station=bruxelles-central
- Arrivals: ?station=bruxelles-central&board=arrivals
- Direct-train filter: ?station=bruxelles-central&to=leuven
- Kiosk mode: add &kiosk=1
- A departing train: ?station=bruxelles-central&train=<number>&dep=<scheduled
  departure, Unix seconds>
- An arriving train: ?station=bruxelles-central&board=arrivals&train=<number>
  &arr=<scheduled arrival, Unix seconds>

## Historical Performance

The figures are calculated by this project from Infrabel Open Data historical
arrival delays. They describe past runs of this train at this station only.
They are not predictions about any journey, and they are not official
SNCB/NMBS, Infrabel or iRail statistics.

## Accuracy

Live railway information may occasionally be delayed, incomplete, inaccurate
or temporarily unavailable. Nothing shown here is a guarantee of service.
Official travel information should be checked with the relevant railway
operator.

## Links

- iRail API documentation: https://docs.irail.be/
- Infrabel Open Data: https://opendata.infrabel.be/
- SNCB/NMBS (official travel information): https://www.belgiantrain.be/
